_readme: Books held at the number of rows with no hq_city and no city_unknown flag that they carried when the city rule landed (2026-09-24, Erik: 'go ahead with 1 & 2'). `run.py verify` prints each book's debt and fails only if the count GROWS, so no book that was green went red and no new row can arrive without a city. A book not listed here, and every new book, is held strictly. A city pass (re-run `prepare`, which now asks for the city, then judge it) clears a book: lower its number or remove it. Lux and Felicis are deliberately absent; their city pass ran the day the rule landed. Counts measured with `verify --skip-links --skip-cross` on 2026-09-24.
